brief_rationale: The doctor correctly identified suspected pediatric medication ingestion, completed systematic red flag screening, obtained medication details with workspace verification, distinguished tests from medications, gave layered safety-netting instructions, and obtained caregiver read-back with no responsibility-chain errors. Multiple high-order points were completed: patient misinformation correction (HO1), avoiding false-positive/false-negative reasoning traps (HO3), and real-world constraint navigation with low-friction execution paths (HO4). With three completed high-order points and no in-chain errors, the trajectory merits grade 5.
